notes: This doctor's full public name is 'Dr. Vamshi Krishna M'. Identity confirmed on three assigned facts - specialty (Medical Oncology), hospital (AIG Hospitals) and branch/city (Gachibowli, Hyderabad) - carried together by the AIG-domain page https://aighospitals.com/doctor-profile/dr-vamshi-krishna-m and independently repeated by Credihealth, HexaHealth, Practo, ZenOnco, DoctorSpring and MediGence, plus a news post naming him 'from AIG Hyderabad, Head of the Department'. SAME-NAME DISAMBIGUATION (this is a very common Telugu name - FOUR distinct people were encountered and none were merged): (1) THIS doctor, Dr. Vamshi Krishna M, Director & HOD Medical Oncology, AIG Gachibowli - the row 1214 subject; (2) Dr. K. Vamshi Krishna, Neurosurgery, CARE Hospitals HITEC City - the separate row 517 subject, different specialty and different hospital group; (3) Dr. P Vamsi Krishna, Urology, CARE Hospitals Banjara Hills - the separate row 591 subject, different specialty and different hospital group; (4) Dr. G. Vamshi Krishna Reddy, Medical Oncology, Yashoda Hospitals Malakpet (https://www.yashodahospitals.com/doctor/malakpet/medical-oncology/dr-g-vamshi-krishna-reddy/) - THE MOST DANGEROUS CONFUSION of the set, because he shares the SAME specialty and the SAME city, differing only by the 'G.'/'Reddy' elements and by hospital group; nothing from his Yashoda pages is recorded here. A fifth near-miss also sits inside AIG itself: Dr. Koneru Vamsi Krishna, a NEUROLOGIST at AIG (https://aighospitals.com/doctor/dr-koneru-vamsi-krishna) - same hospital, different specialty - likewise kept separate. Every field above was taken only from pages that state Medical Oncology AND AIG together. AIG URL PATTERN FINDING (first AIG rows in this dataset; full detail is recorded in row_1213 notes and repeated in row_1215): (a) YES, aighospitals.com publishes per-doctor profile pages. (b) Four URL families were seen verbatim - https://aighospitals.com/doctor/<dr-name-slug> (singular, commonest), https://aighospitals.com/doctors/<dr-name-slug> (plural, older, some now 404), https://aighospitals.com/doctor-profile/<dr-name-slug> (the form used for THIS doctor), and https://aighospitals.com/doctor-profile/<numeric-id>. This row is the clearest proof that one doctor can hold pages in more than one family at once: both /doctor-profile/dr-vamshi-krishna-m and /doctors/dr-vamshi-krishna surfaced for him, and a Google-Translate wrapper additionally exposed a /doctor/dr-vamshi-krishna-m form. Never construct these - always search them out. (c) The doctor-page pattern encodes NEITHER department NOR, in its default form, branch; specialty appears only as a numeric query parameter on listing pages (?speciality=21, ?speciality=26), and branch only as an optional leading segment ('/gcb/' Gachibowli, '/bh/' Banjara Hills) used mainly on speciality and doctor-search pages. CONTACTS: no email or phone for him appeared verbatim on any indexed page across three queries, so both are blank rather than derived. ZenOnco, MediGence, DoctorSpring, HexaHealth and Credihealth booking lines were not recorded - they are aggregator helplines that reach the aggregator, not the doctor. Band Medium: the aighospitals.com pages count as ONE official source and everything else found is corroborating-only.
